items.summaryEn:
"With ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ coming out in cinemas soon, we’re doing a special livery and fan event to celebrate. It’s great to be able to host these additional events on top of activating at track, so we’re looking forward to a great home race.” 🗣️ AK
All set for Austin as Ayao, Esteban and Ollie preview our home race 🇺🇸
#HaasF1 #F1 #USGP
detailZh:
“随着‘Godzilla Minus Zero’即将在影院上映，我们正在举办一场特别的涂装和粉丝活动来庆祝。能够在赛道活动之外还能举办这些额外活动真是太好了，所以我们非常期待一场精彩的本土赛事。” 🗣️ AK
艾亚奥、埃斯特班和奥利提前预览我们的本土赛事，一切准备就绪。 🇺🇸
#哈斯F1 #F1 #美国大奖赛
detailEn:
